The paternal grandmother of the 3rd Baron is the mother of the 3rd Baron's father (the 2nd Baron), not the mother of the 2nd Baron's father (the 1st Baron). This fundamental misunderstanding of the lineage structure led to the incorrect final answer of "Jane Rachel Lewis" instead of the correct answer, "Henrietta Susanna Tracy."
